evidence.statement: Q2 2026 net revenues and financial income were $10.169B, up 49.8% YoY; H1 revenue was $19.014B versus $12.725B.
Q2 operating income was $683M versus $825M and Q2 net income was $466M versus $523M; operating margin was 6.7%, roughly 550bp below Q2 2025.
Q2 GMV reached $21.9B, up 44% reported and 36% FX-neutral; TPV reached $101B, up 56%.
Commerce buyers reached 89M, up 26% YoY; Mercado Pago MAUs reached 88M, up 30%; AUM reached $23B, up 68%.
Credit portfolio surpassed $16B, up 75% YoY. Credit cards rose to 47% of total credit portfolio; consolidated NIMAL was 20.7% and credit-card NIMAL was -2.5%.
H1 provision for doubtful accounts was $2.520B versus $1.293B, while Q2 provision was $1.276B versus $690M.
H1 2026 adjusted FCF was $158M versus $512M in H1 2025; Q2 adjusted FCF was $214M. H1 capex was $712M.

H1 operating cash flow was large, but the increase was materially supported by customer funds, card-settlement payables and other financial working-capital movements; it is not comparable to software-company owner FCF.

At June 30, cash and cash equivalents were $3.649B, restricted cash $13.114B and funds payable to customers $16.035B; company-defined total debt was $13.176B and net debt $6.425B in the canonical raw extraction.
Outstanding shares were 50,696,802 at June 30, 2026 versus 50,697,182 at December 31, 2025, indicating no material dilution over the period.
Brazil FX-neutral GMV grew 39% and items sold grew 56% after lower free-shipping thresholds; Mexico FX-neutral GMV grew 26% and Argentina 38%.

Management reported that ecosystemic users grew 37%, ecosystemic users generate materially higher GMV/TPV and engagement than single-product users, and contribution profit per ecosystemic user is multiples of the sum of marketplace-only and fintech-only users.
Management reported surpassing 10% Latin American digital-ad-market share and 62% FX-neutral ad-revenue growth in Q2 2026.
EMARKETER expects Latin American retail e-commerce sales to grow by $54.45B over the next two years and expects Mercado Libre plus Amazon to capture roughly two-thirds of the incremental sales.
FY2025 financial statements and internal control over financial reporting received unqualified audit opinions.

Founder Marcos Galperin transitioned to Executive Chairman on January 1, 2026 and Ariel Szarfsztejn became CEO; the proxy describes independent board leadership and committee oversight. The Galperin Trust held about 7.0%.

Q2 2026 legal/tax disclosures included $172M probable proceeding liabilities net of judicial deposits, up to $622M reasonably possible legal actions, a $632M provision and $593M judicial deposits for a Brazil withholding-tax dispute, and other tax uncertainties.
MercadoLibre raised $1B through a ten-year U.S. dollar bond due 2036 on September 9, 2026; this checkpoint does not assert an unverified coupon.
The latest completed U.S. close available at research time was $1,876.33 on September 9, 2026.
Using FY2025 plus H1 2026 minus H1 2025, TTM revenue is approximately $35.182B.
Using FY2025 plus H1 2026 minus H1 2025, TTM operating income is approximately $2.907B, or about 8.3% of revenue, and TTM net income about $1.863B.
TTM adjusted FCF equals approximately $1.127B using $1.481B FY2025 + $0.158B H1 2026 - $0.512B H1 2025.
Commerce, logistics, payments, credit, loyalty and ads are reinforcing a multi-product network effect, and the moat is more likely widening than shrinking.
The central underwriting tension is not demand growth but whether free-shipping and credit-card reinvestment produce after-loss, after-required-capital returns above the 9% hurdle.

source_resolution: Source details and URLs are stored in reviews/2026-09-10-app-meli-deep/source-manifest.json.
limitations: Management-reported ecosystemic-user profitability and digital-ad-market share are not independently audited measures.
Restricted cash and customer funds are not surplus corporate cash and are not added mechanically to equity value.
Credit growth requires bank-like vintage, loss, funding and required-capital analysis; total CFO is not used as owner FCF.
The new September 2026 bond confirms funding access but exact coupon/pricing is not asserted here.
Valuation model is a scenario framework with wide uncertainty, not a target-price claim.
